description: This file declares functions and includes required libraries for managing actions in the icrule component, related to parsing XML nodes, handling linked lists, and hash maps.

methods.name: icrule_action_list_load
methods.description: Loads a list of actions from a specified file into a hash map.

methods.name: icrule_action_list_release
methods.description: Releases the resources associated with an action list stored in a hash map.

methods.name: icrule_free_action
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for an action.

methods.name: icrule_free_parameter
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a key-value parameter.

methods.name: icrule_parse_action
methods.description: Parses XML nodes to extract and populate actions into a linked list and action map.
